concerns.text: The plan relies on a fully synthetic solar‑wind composition dataset because no open ACE/WIND composition source exists. This directly violates Constitution Principle VI (Composition Data Integrity) and means the project cannot answer the core scientific question about the real relationship between composition ratios and geomagnetic indices. Using synthetic data only validates the workflow, not the hypothesis.

Even if the workflow were sound, the synthetic composition ratios are generated from assumed statistical distributions rather than measured ion fluxes. This compromises construct validity: the synthetic ratios may not capture the true physical variability or correlations present in real ACE/WIND data, so any statistical significance observed would not generalize to the real Sun‑Earth system.
